basics.name: Shivprasad Sagare
basics.label: Applied Scientist 2 at Microsoft | LLMs, Multimodal AI, NLP & Speech
basics.summary: Applied Scientist with 5+ years of research and engineering experience across LLM post-training, fast inference, real-time search ranking, audio-visual multimodal models, speech recognition, and multilingual NLP.

work.name: Microsoft
highlights: Building AI systems for query suggestions across Bing and Copilot, powering Related Searches, People Also Ask, and Copilot suggestion chips.
Trained LLMs such as Qwen-3 for generating query suggestions using reinforcement learning techniques (DPO).
Optimized LLM inference performance, delivering 4x higher throughput through FP8 quantization and model distillation.
Trained lightweight BERT-based ranking models for real-time suggestion ranking under 10ms latency.
Led development of LLM-based evaluation metrics (LLM-as-a-judge), tuning prompts to correlate with human judgements.

work.name: PhroneticAI
highlights: Conducted research on multimodal LLMs for video analytics, jointly utilizing audio (Whisper), visual (SigLIP), and text (Phi-2 / LLaVA) signals with spatio-temporal pooling.
Built VideoRAG to index keyframes and retrieve query-relevant video frames before passing them to Video-QA models.
Developed and deployed lightweight video understanding models (Owlet family) for video summarization and real-time activity detection.
Presented first-author research paper and VideoRAG system demo at INLG 2024, Tokyo, Japan.

work.name: NeuralSpace
highlights: Built large-scale audio datasets (10,000+ hours) and trained Speech-to-Text (STT) models including OpenAI Whisper and Wav2Vec2.
Worked on speaker diarization, vocabulary adaptation, dialect classification, and voice activity detection.
Deployed models with Python, FastAPI, Docker, Kubernetes, and Azure, and maintained REST APIs and Python SDK.
Adopted LLM and RAG innovations to improve chatbot accuracy and Question-Answering capabilities.

work.name: Language Technologies and Research Centre (LTRC), IIIT Hyderabad
highlights: Built cross-lingual datasets across 11+ Indic languages for fact-to-text generation (0.45M samples, XAlign) and encyclopedic multi-document summarization (100K samples, XWikiGen).
Led human annotation of golden evaluation datasets (6,000+ samples) with 80 crowd-workers across India.
Modified and fine-tuned BERT, GPT, T5/mT5, mBART, and Indic-BERT for multilingual text generation in low-resource languages.
Published research at The Web Conference (WWW 2022, WWW 2023), INLG 2023, and ICON 2021.

work.name: TomTom
highlights: Developed a proof-of-concept data visualization dashboard on AWS infrastructure.
Built a UI in Angular and Spring Boot to streamline transaction management.

education.institution: International Institute of Information Technology, Hyderabad (IIIT-H)
courses: Thesis: Cross-lingual approaches for text generation tasks in low-resource languages
Advisors: Prof. Vasudeva Varma and Dr. Manish Gupta

publications.name: Audio-visual training for improved grounding in video-text LLMs
publications.publisher: INLG 2024: 17th International Natural Language Generation Conference
publications.summary: Proposed an audio-visual LLM architecture trained explicitly on audio and visual streams from video instruction-tuning data, demonstrating stronger response grounding over vision-only baselines and releasing an audio-aware QA benchmark.

publications.name: VideoRAG: Scaling the context size and relevance for video question-answering
publications.publisher: INLG 2024: 17th International Natural Language Generation Conference (System Demonstrations)
publications.summary: Built a retrieval-augmented generation pipeline to index keyframes and select top-k query-relevant frames for Video-QA, significantly improving needle-in-a-haystack performance on long videos.

publications.name: XF2T: Cross-lingual Fact-to-Text Generation for Low-Resource Languages
publications.publisher: INLG 2023: 16th International Natural Language Generation Conference
publications.summary: Investigated pretraining strategies, fact-aware embeddings, and structure-aware input encodings across 12 languages, showing consistent gains with multilingual mT5.

publications.name: XWikiGen: Cross-lingual Summarization for Encyclopedic Text Generation in Low Resource Languages
publications.publisher: WWW 2023: Proceedings of the ACM Web Conference 2023 (CORE A*)
publications.summary: Introduced cross-lingual multi-document summarization for generating Wikipedia-style sections in low-resource languages, releasing the XWikiRef benchmark spanning ~69K Wikipedia articles across eight languages.

publications.name: XAlign: Cross-lingual Fact-to-Text Alignment and Generation for Low-Resource Languages
publications.publisher: WWW 2022: Companion Proceedings of the Web Conference 2022 (CORE A*)
publications.summary: Proposed unsupervised cross-lingual fact-to-text alignment and released the XAlign benchmark of 0.45M aligned pairs (including 5,402 human-annotated pairs) across 8 Indian languages.

publications.name: Cross-lingual Alignment of Knowledge Graph Triples with Sentences
publications.publisher: ICON 2021: 18th International Conference on Natural Language Processing
publications.summary: Developed unsupervised cross-lingual alignment between English knowledge graph triples and Hindi sentences using NER-based semantic filtering and key-phrase relevance ranking.
